##### Project general facts

Golf Hills is a contemporary residential development that combines elegant architecture with the tranquility of lush green surroundings and panoramic golf course views. Offering a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive three-bedroom townhouses, the project has been thoughtfully designed to create a harmonious living environment where natural beauty and modern sophistication exist in perfect balance. Expansive windows, open-plan layouts, and refined architectural details fill each residence with natural light while seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor spaces.

Residents enjoy a carefully curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to promote wellness, recreation, and relaxation. The development features an infinity-edge swimming pool, indoor and outdoor fitness facilities, an 18-hole golf course, dedicated children's play areas, landscaped walking paths, and beautifully maintained green spaces. Every element has been designed to foster an active, peaceful, and family-friendly lifestyle surrounded by nature.

The residences are finished using high-quality materials that reflect a contemporary and refined design philosophy. Elegant interiors combine premium finishes with functional layouts, creating comfortable and timeless living spaces. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Emaar South offers a range of residential options, including apartments, townhouses, and villas, catering to the diverse needs and preferences of residents. The architecture is often characterized by modern design and amenities. The community's strategic location near the Expo 2020 site and the Al Maktoum International Airport enhances its appeal for both residents and businesses. This proximity can be advantageous for those looking for convenient travel options and business opportunities.

Emaar South is designed with a focus on creating a harmonious living environment. This includes well-maintained green spaces, parks, and landscaped areas where residents can relax, play, and enjoy outdoor activities. Residents of Emaar South can typically access a variety of world-class amenities. These may include community centers, swimming pools, sports facilities, and fitness centers, contributing to a vibrant and active lifestyle.

The development may feature commercial areas with retail spaces, providing residents with shopping and dining options within the community itself. Given its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport and major road networks, residents of Emaar South may benefit from excellent transportation connectivity, making commuting within Dubai and beyond more convenient.
